messages:
Omar H.: Tiny kudos thread — huge thank you to Laura P. for staying late to get the customer VPN back up and also bringing homemade tamales for the on-call crew. Legendary energy :tada: :tamale:
Laura P.: surprised the VPN was picky about an expired cert. Fixed and reheated tamales at 10:30pm. Happy to help and share recipe if anyone wants it :chef_kiss:
DevOps Team: shoutout to Marta for spotting the config drift earlier in the day, saved us an hour of sleuthing :mag:
Marta L.: team effort. Lauras tamales were the morale booster that turned debugging into a party :sparkles:
Omar H.: vote: how should we reward? react with :plate_with_cutlery: for team lunch, :gift: for mystery snack box, :keycap: for custom engraved keycap ("VPN Smasher"). Poll open 48h
OpsBot: Poll opened by Omar H. react to vote. Poll will auto-close in 48 hours.
Laura P.: :plate_with_cutlery: (I will bring a tamale masterclass if we pick lunch)
Marta L.: :keycap: (those keycaps would be adorable on the ops keyboard)
DevOps Team: :gift: (snack box for on-call rotation sounds practical)
Omar H.: adding to wins board and retro shoutouts. Seriously thank you both small gestures like this keep us going.
